Our current WMS lacks accurate physical data for our inventory, preventing us from modelling capacity or slotting strategies properly. We need a specialist to clean our product master data and engineer missing weights, dimensions, and stackability metrics for approximately 25,000 SKUs to support a new distribution capacity model. Deliverable: a validated dataset of engineered product specifications covering the majority of our active inventory. Engagement duration: 4-5 weeks.

hire_title: Fire Safety Strategy Review for Specialist Hospital
hire_description: I run a specialist medical centre in Singapore with several operating theatres and patient wards. Before we hand over the building or undergo inspection, we need an independent expert to review our fire and life safety strategy. You’ll check the design against local regulations, review the cause and effect matrix for our systems, and verify the commissioning of those fire safety systems. Deliverable: written assessment report with design compliance notes and commissioning verification findings. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Set Up Cloud ERP for New Industrial Services Startup
hire_description: We are a new industrial services startup in Singapore, formed from a carve-out, with 20 employees and plans to grow to 100 in 18 months. We need to set up our core business systems fast, without hiring an in-house IT team. We’re launching with a cloud-based ERP to manage finance, operations, and HR, and we need someone to design and implement the core system for our first office. The specialist will configure Acumatica for our needs, set up Microsoft 365 for communication and collaboration, and ensure data flows correctly between systems. Deliverable: fully configured Acumatica ERP and Microsoft 365 environment with documentation and training materials. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: Develop Clean Energy Investment Portfolio for Industrial Area
hire_description: We’re a precision components manufacturer with 35 staff in Jurong, and we want to reduce our carbon footprint by investing in on-site clean energy. We need someone to design a decarbonisation plan for our factory, focusing on energy efficiency, solar PV, and heat recovery. The specialist should assess our current energy use, identify feasible technologies, and create a prioritised investment roadmap. Deliverable: a tailored investment portfolio plan with cost estimates and implementation steps. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Environmental Site Assessment for Industrial Facility
hire_description: We are a precision components manufacturer with 35 workers in Singapore, planning to divest one of our production facilities. We need someone to carry out a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) for this site, including a desktop review, on-site interviews, and compliance check against local environmental rules. The assessment must identify any potential environmental liabilities and estimate associated costs. Deliverable: completed Phase I ESA report with liability assessment and cost estimate. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: CrowdStrike Deployment for Quick-Service Restaurant Chain
hire_description: We run a quick-service restaurant chain with 15 outlets across Singapore and need to strengthen our cybersecurity quickly. Our IT team is small and can’t handle a large deployment, so we need someone to deploy CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Protection across all our locations in under 24 hours. The specialist must set up Falcon, configure endpoint protection, and ensure seamless integration with our existing systems. Deliverable: fully deployed CrowdStrike Falcon environment with operational endpoint protection across all sites. Engagement duration: 1-2 days.

hire_title: Design AI System Card Template for Internal Governance
hire_description: We are a mid-sized asset management firm in Singapore with 120 staff, deploying generative AI tools for client reporting and research. We need to improve transparency and governance of our AI systems before they go live. We want someone to design a simple, structured AI system card template that documents key aspects like system purpose, data sources, performance metrics, limitations, and risks. This should align with our internal AI governance policies and help us comply with MAS guidelines on AI use in financial services. Deliverable: editable AI system card template with clear fields and guidance notes. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Indoor Air Quality Plan for Office Fit-out
hire_description:
I am setting up office space in Singapore and need to ensure good indoor air quality (IAQ) during the fit-out. We are working with contractors and suppliers and need someone to help manage the IAQ aspects of the works. Please review material submittals to ensure low-emission products are selected, and advise on construction site ventilation and dust control to protect workers and future occupants. I need you to conduct a couple of spot checks on site during the active build phase to verify controls are in place.
Deliverable: IAQ management plan and material approval notes.
Engagement duration: 2-4 weeks.

hire_title: Trademark Clearance Search for New Product
hire_description: We are a small Singapore-based CPG brand with a team of 12, preparing to launch a new snack line. Before we invest in packaging and marketing, we need to confirm our proposed brand name is available. We need a specialist to conduct a trademark clearance search to identify any conflicting registrations or pending applications in Singapore and relevant regional jurisdictions. The goal is to identify potential obstacles before we file for registration. Deliverable: written clearance report with risk assessment and next steps. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

hire_title: AI-Assisted Document Review for Legal Dispute
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based consumer products company with 40 staff facing a complex commercial dispute over brand misuse and contractual payments. We need to review an initial dataset of about 80,000 emails and documents to support our legal defence. We require a specialist to deploy Relativity aiR for Review to perform the first-pass review, including prompt development, tuning with our legal terms, and statistically validating the AI's performance to ensure legal defensibility. This will significantly reduce the volume of documents requiring manual human review. Deliverable: validated AI review workflow and reduced document set ready for legal counsel. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Architect Cloud ERP Strategy for Startup
hire_description: We are a newly carved-out industrial maintenance firm with 200 staff and six Singapore sites. Our PE investors require us to scale rapidly while keeping IT costs under 1% of revenue. We need a specialist to design our cloud-based IT architecture. Please recommend a cloud ERP and collaboration stack that integrates our operations without requiring local server infrastructure. Focus on vendor negotiations and license brokering to ensure low total cost of ownership. Deliverable: architectural roadmap and vendor recommendation report. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Rail infrastructure maintenance plan review
hire_description: We operate a small regional rail line in Singapore facing ageing tracks and need a 15-year maintenance roadmap to meet SMRT licensing standards. Review our current asset inventory and project sequencing to identify funding gaps and schedule conflicts that cause delays. Deliverable: prioritised capital renewal plan with a timeline of works. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: LEED Gold Consultancy for Oncology Clinic Expansion
hire_description: We are a private oncology clinic in Singapore expanding our facilities to include radiation therapy and chemotherapy services. We need a specialist to help us achieve LEED Gold certification for this new wing. The work involves reviewing the design, identifying sustainability features, and preparing documentation to meet LEED requirements. Deliverable: LEED certification application package including design analysis, sustainability strategy, and compliance documentation. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: NetSuite ERP assessment for cafe chain
hire_description:
A six-outlet cafe chain in Singapore needs to modernise its back-office systems to support franchise growth and improve financial visibility. Currently, operations are siloed, causing delays in month-end reporting and limiting real-time insight into inventory and order fulfillment. The hirer requires a specialist to assess current processes and design a migration plan to a unified NetSuite cloud ERP, ensuring the new platform can scale alongside the brand without disrupting daily franchise operations.

Deliverable: ERP implementation blueprint and migration strategy aligned to franchise operations. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Cost Optimization Review for Telecom Division
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based telecom operator with 120 staff. Our legacy division is eroding margins, and we need to demonstrate cost-saving potential to stakeholders before discussing recapitalization. We need a specialist to review our back-office operations and infrastructure spend to identify efficiency opportunities. Focus on network operational excellence and asset management strategies to quantify potential upside. Deliverable: A cost optimization plan detailing specific savings initiatives with estimated one-time and ongoing costs. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Environmental and Social Assessment for Manufacturing Facility
hire_description: We run a manufacturing facility in Singapore producing photographic film, and we need to assess potential environmental and social liabilities before a planned site expansion. We’re engaging a specialist to conduct a Phase I Environmental and Social Assessment (ESA) to review operations, identify any compliance risks with local regulations, and recommend next steps. This includes reviewing site history, operations, and regulatory records. Deliverable: written Phase I ESA report with findings and recommendations. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Streamline month-end close and costing in Dynamics 365
hire_description: We are a small food manufacturer in Singapore facing slow, manual month-end closes and unreliable production costing. We need a specialist to configure Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance to automate our financial close processes, replace our spreadsheet-based workflows, and ensure accurate real-time visibility into costs. Deliverable: a working configuration in Dynamics 365 Finance that automates the month-end close and provides accurate production cost tracking. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Review ECD Programme Delivery Model for Refugee Community Facilitators
hire_description: We run a community-based early childhood development programme in a refugee settlement in Singapore, using locally recruited facilitators to deliver play-based, trauma-informed sessions. We’ve seen strong engagement but need to improve consistency and impact. We need someone to review our current delivery model, assess facilitator training and supervision, and identify gaps in programme fidelity and home environment support. This includes evaluating how well we’re integrating with local social services and supporting caregivers’ mental health. Deliverable: written assessment with recommendations for improving delivery quality and sustainability. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Fire & Life Safety Consultancy for Pavilion
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based event design firm preparing a temporary pavilion structure for an international expo. The building has four structural levels containing auditoriums, a restaurant, and meeting rooms. We need a specialist to handle the Fire & Life Safety consultancy to ensure the design meets safety standards for public assembly spaces. Deliverable: Fire & Life Safety design report and compliance checklist. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Biological Survey for Site Remediation Project
hire_description: We are a property holding company in Singapore managing a legacy industrial site near Tuas that requires clean-up. Before we start the physical remediation, we need to complete the required environmental surveys. We need a specialist to conduct the biological survey of the site to identify any critical wildlife habitat or plant communities that must be preserved. This ensures our restoration plan meets local environmental standards and allows us to proceed with contractor bidding. Deliverable: a biological survey report detailing species present and conservation constraints. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Forensic Analysis of Gift Card Fraud Transactions
hire_description: We operate a mid-sized retail chain in Singapore with a private label credit card. Since shifting to e-commerce, we’ve seen a 30-fold spike in electronic gift card purchases, totaling S$1.5 million. We need a specialist to investigate whether this is data theft or a process failure. The work involves analysing transaction authorizations to see if PANs are accepted without CVV or expiry checks, and reviewing how card numbers were generated. Deliverable: forensic report identifying the fraud vector and specific control gaps. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Review AI Compliance Tool for Telecommunications Regulatory Mapping
hire_description: We are a mid-sized telecommunications provider in Singapore with 120 staff, operating across three districts. We’re using AI to interpret new regulatory requirements, but need to ensure our internal teams can trust and use the tool effectively. We need someone to review how our AI system — using Microsoft OpenAI — maps regulatory text to internal controls, assess its accuracy and usability, and check if it meets our compliance needs under IMDA regulations. Deliverable: report with findings, confidence assessment, and recommendations for use. Engagement duration: 3-5 weeks.

hire_title: Carbon Baseline and Net Zero Roadmap
hire_description: We are a 150-bed private hospital in Singapore preparing to commit to a Net Zero target. We need to quantify our current carbon emissions and map a path to reduction. You will collect utility and fuel data to calculate our baseline in accordance with the GHG Protocol. Based on these figures, you will develop a reduction roadmap aligned with our 2040 Net Zero goal. Deliverable: A carbon baseline report and a phased Net Zero roadmap. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Assess Data Compliance for One Hospitality Website
hire_description: We run a small hospitality brand in Singapore with one website and a few online booking pages. We’re expanding our digital presence and need to ensure our site complies with Singapore’s PDPA and other data protection rules. We need someone to review our current data collection, consent mechanisms, and privacy policy against PDPA requirements, identify gaps, and suggest fixes. Deliverable: written assessment with findings and a prioritized list of compliance actions. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Socio-economic impact assessment framework for light rail
hire_description: We operate a light rail service in Singapore with 18 months of live operational data. Our management needs to quantify the wider urban value of our route, specifically how it has influenced local employment density and residential development patterns near our stations. We need a specialist to replicate a rigorous, data-driven assessment methodology that compares our performance against transport best practices. This involves analyzing our ridership mix, calculating induced economic activity, and modeling the socio-economic benefits to support our next infrastructure proposal to stakeholders. Deliverable: a comprehensive impact report including an assessment framework template and a prioritized list of key performance indicators for future tracking. Engagement duration: 4-5 weeks.

hire_title: Energy Efficiency Assessment for Heat Transfer Factory
hire_description:
We are a precision components maker in Tuas with 35 staff, producing heat transfer products. To meet our internal goal of reducing energy use by 12% from our 2024 baseline, we need an expert to analyse our consumption. Please apply a DMAIC-based approach to identify major electricity and fuel sources. We found ovens account for most electrical load and LPG is used for heating. We need a review of ventilation, lighting, and process ovens to find efficiency opportunities.

Deliverable: a prioritised list of cost reduction projects with estimated savings. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Build Digital Twin for Chocolate Production Line
hire_description:
A family-owned chocolate manufacturer in Singapore needs a virtual model of its production line to test operational changes without disrupting live output. The specialist must conduct stakeholder interviews and discovery workshops to gather data on equipment needs, demand flows, and business requirements. This data will be synthesised into a digital twin capable of running scenario analyses for staffing and capital investment options.

Deliverable: A working digital twin model with initial scenario analysis results. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: Assess Protection Gaps for Afghan Refugees in Volatile Policy Environment
hire_description: A humanitarian NGO in Singapore supporting Afghan refugees in Pakistan is facing rapid policy changes, including a blanket returns policy, which is outpacing their programme’s ability to adapt. They need someone to review the current protection framework, analyse how it affects vulnerable groups such as transgender persons, women in education, and mixed-marriage families, and assess whether programme assumptions still hold. The specialist will use desk review, key informant interviews, and beneficiary feedback to identify gaps. Deliverable: a short report with findings and recommendations for adaptive programming. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Design Climate Data Integration Architecture
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based development finance team supporting sustainable projects in the region. Our climate data is currently siloed by country, making it hard to align stakeholders and standardise insights for funding decisions. We need a specialist to design a data architecture that integrates these diverse geospatial and risk model datasets into a unified structure. This will allow us to generate consistent insights and accelerate decision-making from a year to a month. Deliverable: a standardized data architecture plan with integration guidelines. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Parametric Façade Design for Event Pavilion
hire_description: We are the project team for a temporary event pavilion in Singapore. We need a specialist to optimise our façade design using parametric modelling to ensure the external fins provide adequate shading for the glazing. The goal is to meet strict sustainability targets for energy reduction and improve outdoor thermal comfort for visitors during the 6-month event. We also need to ensure the design supports the full deconstruction and recycling of materials once the event ends. Deliverable: a parametric façade model with performance data and a deconstruction strategy. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Assess Economic Impact of Offshore Wind Project in Singapore
hire_description: We are a small renewable energy developer in Singapore planning a 100 MW offshore wind project. We need someone to assess the potential economic value and local job creation from this project using input–output analysis and a standard offshore wind cost model. The work should focus on the project’s direct and indirect impacts on the local economy, including supply chain and employment effects. Deliverable: report with economic impact analysis and key recommendations. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
